name: Beach☆Volley!!
source:
Beach☆Volley basically tells the story of 3 characters.
We’ll be putting ourselves in Jun’s shoes – a young man who is about 17 years old – during the most important summer of his life. Jun will spend wonderful moments with the sun, the beach, and his two no less ravishing female friends, Alice and Rin.
And of course, the annual Beach-volleyball competition will be taking place! But the tension increases and settles between the 3 friends… how will this end?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=45382]Lemmasoft Forums[/url]]
translation:
Beach☆Volley基本上讲述了3个角色的故事。
我们将设身处地为Jun——一个大约17岁的年轻人——设身处地地想一想，度过他一生中最重要的夏天。Jun将与阳光、海滩以及他的两个同样迷人的女性朋友Alice和Rin一起度过美好的时光。
当然，一年一度的沙滩排球比赛将会举行！但三个朋友之间的紧张气氛却越来越紧张……这将如何结束？

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=45382]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
